# Drop Whisk — Comprehensive Technical Documentation (llms-full.txt)

> The complete specification and architecture of Drop Whisk, an open-source cross-device file and text sharing system.

## 1. System Architecture
Drop Whisk is constructed as a modern, decoupled web application utilizing:
- **Frontend & App Engine**: Next.js App Router (React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Framer Motion, Lucide Icons).
- **Backend API**: Next.js Route Handlers executing on Node.js runtime.
- **Database Layer**: Prisma ORM with SQLite local storage (configurable to PostgreSQL via Supabase pooler for scale).
- **Real-Time Signaling Service**: Dedicated Socket.io mini-service operating on port 3003 providing sub-second device presence and payload broadcasting.
- **File System Storage**: Chunked streaming local storage mounted at `/storage/uploads/` with auto-purging background TTL cleanup.

## 2. API Endpoints Contract

### REST Endpoints:
- `POST /api/rooms`
  - Creates a new temporary room with a random 6-character alphanumeric code.
  - Returns: `{ id, code, name, createdAt, expiresAt, fileCount, totalSize }`
- `GET /api/rooms/:code`
  - Fetches room metadata, active files, text snippets, and connected devices.
  - Returns 404 if room does not exist or has expired.
- `POST /api/rooms/:code/devices`
  - Registers a device with its friendly name into the room session.
  - Body: `{ name, socketId? }`
- `POST /api/rooms/:code/upload`
  - Multipart form-data file upload handler.
  - Validates file size (max 500 MB per file).
  - Persists file to storage disk and records metadata in database.
  - Returns: `FileMeta { id, roomId, name, originalName, size, mimeType, kind, deviceName, createdAt }`
- `GET /api/files/:id`
  - Streams or downloads a specific uploaded file by its unique file ID with appropriate Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers.
- `DELETE /api/rooms/:code/files?fileId=:id`
  - Removes a file from storage and database.
- `POST /api/rooms/:code/texts`
  - Adds a new text snippet to the shared clipboard.
  - Body: `{ content, deviceName }`
- `DELETE /api/rooms/:code/texts?textId=:id`
  - Deletes a shared text snippet.
- `GET /api/rooms/:code/zip`
  - Dynamic streaming ZIP archive generator using `archiver`.
  - Bundles all room files on the fly into a single `.zip` download.

### WebSocket Signaling Events (Port 3003):
- `join_room { roomCode, deviceName }` -> Server replies with `join_ok` and broadcasts `device_joined` to peers.
- `send_text { roomCode, content, deviceName }` -> Server relays `text_received` to all other connected peers.
- `send_file_signal { roomCode, file }` -> Server relays `file_uploaded` to all connected peers immediately.
- `send_delete_signal { roomCode, fileId }` -> Server relays `file_deleted` to all peers.
- `disconnect` -> Broadcasts `device_left` with device ID.

## 3. Security, Privacy & Compliance
- **Zero Identification**: No cookies for tracking, no analytics telemetry, no email or personal identity stored.
- **Ephemeral Rooms**: 24-hour Time-to-Live (TTL). When a room reaches 24 hours from creation, room entries and all associated files are deleted from the disk and database.
- **Safe Filenames**: Uploaded filenames are sanitized and stored with cryptographically secure cuid prefixes to prevent path traversal and arbitrary execution.

## 4. Key Performance Indicators
- **Connection Latency**: Sub-second peer discovery upon QR scan or room code input.
- **Transfer Throughput**: Near wire-speed HTTP chunked uploads and direct downloads up to 500 MB.
- **Zero Battery Drain**: No persistent background polling or Bluetooth discovery daemons.
